messages.subject: Use additional packages whithin shiny-server
parts:
Hi,

First of all : Thanks a lot for your work on Shiny ! It's fun and usefull.

I would like to run in my shiny app a few calculation who needs additional packages. 
It works locally (runapp ...) but when i try on shiny-server it print "Error : there is no package called MyPackage".
My code is : 

server.r :

output$test<-renderPrint({
library(actuar)

model.freq <- expression(data = rpois(3))

model.sev <- expression(data = rlnorm(10, 1.5))

Fs <- aggregateDist("simulation", model.freq, model.sev, nb.simul = 1000)

quantile(Fs, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75))

print(VaR(Fs))

})


Should i do specific manipulation to help me to use packages also with shiny-server ?


Thanks a lot,

Jean

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Use additional packages whithin shiny-server
parts:
If you install these packages while running as either root (to make it available for everyone on the server) or as the "shiny" user, then it should work under shiny-server. For example:

sudo su -
R
(from R prompt:) install.packages("your-package-name")

Or:

sudo su - shiny
R
(from R prompt:) install.packages("your-package-name")
